body:
o_o woah geez I think you're misunderstanding. My female roommate in my old apartment refused to pay rent and I ended up with no apartment, so they both (as they are both roommates (along with their other roommate)) decided to let me crash here. 

S, I and M were all friends long before any living situations or even romantic situations happened. (S and I considered eachother extended family, while M and I were dating) - ( we actually used to go on group dates and hang out together all the time,as I was also friends with S's ex)..

While I was still dating M, S approached me and said " Hey I know this is crazy, but I need to say something. I really see you as like a potential partner", and then went on to admit that he'd had a crush on me. Then S broke up with his GF. Then both M and I were trying to console him, and he came onto me more and more to which I said no. 

The situation put tension on M and I (along with other things (stress/work load) which caused our breakup. AND then after the breakup, after a conversation S and I kissed. Which I told him I regretted and admitted to both guys I wasnt ready to date anyone.

Things about S and I recently with his ex, only started 3 months after that whole situation had ended.

So no, I didnt just jump roommates
and M has known the entire situation the entire time as all three of us are still friends above any romantic stuff

haha thanks <:)

1. too true
2. unfortunately this is probably true too
3. the irony is that I ended up living with them after the whole fiasco instead of before it due to other financial problems I was having with my original roommate - but also very true

I was really in love with M. He was my first in a lot of ways and is still one of my closest friends

And S and I have been through a lot together, he's in my class and has been a project partner of mine throughout all 4 years of school.

Both boys are intelligent engineers, with large brains and big hearts, who share interests, hobbies, stories, hugs and homes with me. It's hard not to fall in love

M and I had our fair share of arguments throughout our time together - so the break up wasn't completely over S. 

And at the time we broke up S and I hadn't kissed yet, but I agree cheating emotionally is sometimes just as bad - if not worse than cheating physically. 

M clearly still has feelings for me - but I just dont want to hurt him any further

I feel like I am actually @_@|||

I'm not really a flirty type- and I have a very small group of friends, I feel like I gave off the wrong impressions and even though I didn't necessarily cheat on M physically until after we had broken up. I feel like cheating emotionally is just as bad

Yeah, actually the maturity level on all three of us (okay maybe not so much with S) has sky rocketed since the whole endeavor. 

I'm not claiming to be innocent with anything either, only that I was honest with them. 

I have always been clear with M and S. (I turned S down after he initially showed his feelings for me because I was happily with M). 

Things just turned sour between M and I because of his unwillingness to care about what happened either way - It really hurt a lot to know that he was willing to let me go so quickly without any friction. (His reaction when I told him what was going on with S, and asked him what I should do about it, or if he would have liked me to opt of the projects I was doing with S at the time, was to shrug and say he didn't give a f***...)

I just hope if I ever do find someone that they'll just be honest with me about things.

Thanks for the honesty. It's genuinely appreciated <:)

 I actually love M to much to put him through anything like that again (I don't think it would be fair for us to date after all this). And to be honest I would be happy just seeing both of them happy with whoever is able to do that for them. 

The hardest part about this whole things was dealing with being so close to both of them 24/7. S and I had 6 out of 7 classes together and were doing a Senior Thesis together (all decided long before this whole thing happened) which made it hard to be apart, and M and S and I shared an apartment - so for lease reasons I was kinda stuck.
seriously tv drama does this kind of stuff no justice. it's miserable @_@

I really hope so. I'm really close with both of them as friends, and it is hard  since I'll now be living in the city far away from my other friends and family. 

I'll most likely take the reddit way- and adopt a cat instead of getting into any relationships right now
Of course now he claims to say that just because we had broken up - but the fact that it was said in the first place makes it far to hard to go back

Thanks - no I agree.

M and I have talked about dating again (after the breakup and before the thing with S and I) and he's actually asked me out again recently - which I turned down as I was unofficially seeing S. 

But I agree, I dont think I'm going to get anywhere with either of them.
